name: terminal-gym
description: A daily bodyweight rep goal inside Claude Code: log with /fit, quick-log band, long-turn nudges, streaks and a score grid, optional strict mode.

nudges.title: Long-turn nudges
nudges.description: Suggest a set when a turn runs long.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Spread today's goal into sets from your first prompt; fall behind and prompts wait until you catch up (/fit rest breaks your streak instead).

windowHours.title: Training window (hours)
windowHours.description: How long after your first prompt the day's sets are spread over.

setSize.title: Set size
setSize.description: Reps per set; 0 means a tenth of the day's goal, rounded to fives.

nudgeSeconds.title: Nudge after (seconds)
nudgeSeconds.description: How long a turn runs before Terminal Gym suggests a set.

nudgeReps.title: Reps per nudge
nudgeReps.description: Reps suggested per long turn in easy mode.

spinner.title: Spinner takeover
spinner.description: Replace the spinner word with the suggested set during long turns (easy mode).

band.title: Quick-log band
band.description: Show progress and +5/+10/+25 buttons above the prompt.
